stem:
During the course of an action potential, the potential difference across a neurone membrane changes.

Table 10.1 shows the potential difference across the neurone membrane at three sequential time points, **X**, **Y** and **Z**, just before and during an action potential.

Table 10.1

| time point | potential difference $/\text{mV}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| **X** | -70 |
| **Y** | +40 |
| **Z** | -90 |

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the events that cause each of the potential differences at points **X**, **Y** and **Z**.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Suggest how one action potential causes an action potential in an adjacent section of the axon of an unmyelinated neurone.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Vertebrate animals generally have a myelin sheath around the axons of motor neurones.

Explain why the presence of a myelin sheath around a motor neurone axon is an advantage.
